verdict.rationale: monday.com's classic automation engine (recipe-based 'when X then Y' rules) is well-established, and the evidence pack further shows event-based triggers for AI agents (create_item, change_column_value, agent messaged/assigned/mentioned) that kick off automated actions. However, evidence is entirely vendor docs with no independent verification of rule-based automation reliability, and community feedback focuses on unrelated performance/UX complaints rather than confirming automation-depth capability.
